title: Logspace in bounded-error probabilistic logspace
statement: Every language decidable by a deterministic Turing machine using logarithmic space is decidable by a probabilistic Turing machine using logarithmic space with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on members and at most $1/3$ on nonmembers.
